article.headline: Northern Colorado opens season with a 117-64 win over Colorado College
article.description: — Jeremiah Hammond’s 17 points helped Northern Colorado roll to a 117-64 victory over Colorado College on Monday in the Bears’ first game of the season.
article.linkText: Northern Colorado opens season with a 117-64 win over Colorado College

keywords: Colorado College Tigers @ Northern Colorado Bears
article.story: GREELEY, Colo. -- — Jeremiah Hammond’s 17 points helped Northern Colorado roll to a 117-64 victory over Colorado College on Monday in the Bears’ first game of the season. Hammond shot 5 for 9 from the field, including 3 for 5 from 3-point range, and 4 for 5 from the free-throw line. Chiante Tramble shot 5 for 8 from the field and 2 for 3 from the free-throw line to add 13 points. Hunter Caldwell shot 4 for 7 from the field, including 4 for 6 from beyond the arc, to finish with 12 points. Nick Brashear led the Tigers with 13 points and two steals. Bryson Gaines added 12 points for Colorado College. Christian Drummond finished with 11 points. Up next Northern Colorado visits Arizona State on Friday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
